gitPush.helpLocalPaths:
Local Paths (Multiple Computers)
Add the project's paths on different computers. Git operations automatically use the first path that actually exists. Example: E:\projects\repo at home, D:\work\repo at work — no manual switching needed. You can add, edit, or delete paths, but at least one must remain.
gitPush.helpRepoLinks:
Repository Links
Manually entered repository URLs (GitHub/Gitee/Gitea/CNB) are saved with the project in the current SiYuan workspace. They are kept even when the local .git/config has no matching remote, and are restored on other devices once SiYuan sync (S3/WebDAV) is enabled.
gitPush.helpGitRemotes:
Git Remotes (Auto-Read)
These remotes are read from the local repository's .git/config. Click Edit to change a URL or Delete to remove a remote. Changes are applied to the local git repository and the project record is updated as well. If no valid path exists on this computer, the list appears empty.
gitPush.helpPersistence:
Data Saving & Sync
Project name, paths, favorite/archive, notes, and repository links are all saved in the current SiYuan workspace and sync to other devices automatically with SiYuan sync (S3/WebDAV) — no manual backup needed.
